name: io.github.smaniches/semantic-scholar-mcp
title: Semantic Scholar MCP Server
description: MCP server for the Semantic Scholar API: search 200M+ papers, citations, authors, recommendations.

environmentVariables.name: SEMANTIC_SCHOLAR_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Semantic Scholar API key; introductory keys are currently assigned 1 request/second across all endpoints

environmentVariables.name: SEMANTIC_SCHOLAR_MIN_SECONDS_BETWEEN_REQUESTS
environmentVariables.description: Minimum seconds between authenticated requests. Default 1.1; lower only when Semantic Scholar has explicitly assigned the key a higher quota.
